about: File Shield page prose: what it does, and how far its protection reaches today. The page loads this file and renders it as given.
can: Hermes, Blackbox's assistant, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Windsurf, Cline, OpenCode, OpenClaw and their MCP tools — each one's tool calls pass Blackbox's guard
Every route a tool call names
opening, copying, archiving, listing, changing, moving or deleting it, a cd into it, a command over a folder that holds it, code that opens it
Audit mode too: it is your own explicit rule

a coding agent you pick starts inside your Mac's own sandbox: no script, program or interpreter it runs can open, copy, change, move or delete a protected item, or change Blackbox — the kernel refuses it
cannot: What the hooks alone cannot see
a program an agent wrote or downloaded and then runs opens files without naming them in a tool call — only an agent inside the sandbox is stopped there
What the sandbox does not cover

an agent started another way (a full path, an editor that starts it itself), an agent driving another app with AppleEvents, and sudo (a sandboxed agent can not use it); Linux and Windows are not sandboxed yet
